name: Storming Thunderhead
body:
School conjuration (creation) [air]; Level druid 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Effect 40-ft.-radius

Duration 1 round/4 levels

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You create a towering dark storm cloud in the designated area. The area acts as both a fog cloud spell and a wind wall spell, except the cloud is not disbursed by winds. You can see and move normally within the storming thunderhead, though your ranged attacks are still hindered.

Any sonic or electricity spell of 7th level or lower cast within the area is automatically empowered as if by the Empower Spell feat, but with no adjustment to the spell’s level or casting time. This does not empower already empowered spells.
